home.title: Lightweight QR ordering for restaurants, cafés, and banh mi shops
home.subtitle: Foreign guests can't read the menu? Scan the QR code and they order in their own language. Owners run everything from a phone — no POS hardware, no guest app.
home.painBody: Menu language and spoken English are the two hardest parts of serving tourists. A QR menu solves both at once.
home.pain1Body: The menu opens in the guest's own language — up to 5 languages on Pro.
home.pain2Title: Ordering in broken English is painful
home.pain2Body: Guests tap to order instead of explaining at the counter or to a server.
home.pain3Title: Staff and guests both stay relaxed
home.pain3Body: Orders arrive in writing on staff phones. No shouting, no misheard dishes.
home.highlight1Body: Guests scan a QR code to order — nothing to buy or install.
home.highlight2Body: Open the browser, browse the menu, and send the order.
home.highlight3Body: Owners and staff build menus and take orders on a phone.
home.highlight4Body: Build a menu and take your first order at no cost.
home.feature1Body: Customers scan a QR code, open the menu, and submit orders in the browser.
home.feature2Body: Owners register, build menus, and share table or pickup codes without a computer.
home.feature3Body: Support dine-in table codes and short pickup numbers for walk-up shops.
home.howSubtitle: From sign-up to the first order in minutes.
home.howStep1Body: Enter items by hand for free, or photograph a menu and let AI help with Pro.
home.howStep2Body: Table codes or pickup codes — print them on A4 or share a link.
home.howStep3Body: Orders reach staff phones in seconds, with options and special requests.
home.scenariosTitle: Made for the shops that need it
home.scenario1Body: Table service with self-ordering in the guest's language.
home.scenario2Body: Lightweight ordering for dine-in or takeaway — no equipment.
home.scenario3Body: One shared pickup code and short order numbers.
home.scenario4Body: Pickup by number — no more rush-hour chaos.
home.beyondTitle: And there is more to come
home.beyondBody: TaoMenu keeps adding value beyond order taking — available now or on the roadmap.
home.beyond1Body: Make menu photos appetizing with reviewed AI previews (Pro).
home.beyond2Body: Set up combo deals and promotions (in development).
home.beyond3Body: Returning guests, points and repeat orders (in development).
home.faq1Q: Do guests need an app to order?
home.faq1A: No. Guests scan the QR code, open the menu in a browser, and submit their order — no app installation.
home.faq2Q: Can I run this without a computer or POS?
home.faq2A: Yes. A single phone is enough: register, build the menu, receive orders, and record payment.
home.faq3Q: Can the free plan run a real business?
home.faq3A: Yes. Free includes 1 staff seat, 1 menu language, and manual menu entry — enough for a small shop day to day.
home.faq4A: Today, guests pay directly with cash or the shop's own payment QR code — TaoMenu never touches meal money. Online payment is in development.
home.faq5Q: Can guests order in their own language?
home.faq5A: Yes. Pro supports up to 5 menu languages. Translations are AI-assisted and reviewed by the owner before publishing.
home.faq6Q: How long does it take to get started?
home.faq6A: Minutes. Sign up free, build your menu, print or share QR codes — then start taking orders.
home.finalCtaBody: Build your menu, print QR codes, and take your first order today.

phan-mem-order-nha-hang.title: Restaurant ordering software: guests scan, orders reach staff
phan-mem-order-nha-hang.description: QR ordering for restaurants: guests scan a code, browse a menu in their own language, and order straight to staff phones. No POS.
phan-mem-order-nha-hang.answer: TaoMenu is ordering software for restaurants that runs on a phone: guests scan a QR code to view the menu and order, and staff receive orders on their phones. No POS hardware needed.

faq.q: Does the restaurant need to buy hardware?
faq.a: No. Everything runs on the owner's and staff's existing phones; the QR code can be printed on paper.

faq.q: Can guests order in their own language?
faq.a: Yes. Pro supports up to 5 menu languages so tourists can read and order without an interpreter.

faq.q: How do staff get notified of new orders?
faq.a: Orders appear in the staff app within seconds. New-order push notifications are available in the installed PWA.

menu-qr-cho-quan-an.title: QR menu for restaurants: turn your paper menu into a scan-to-view menu
menu-qr-cho-quan-an.description: Create a QR menu for your restaurant, café or shop. Hand-built for free, or import a photo or PDF with Pro.
menu-qr-cho-quan-an.answer: A QR menu is a menu that opens on a phone when scanned. TaoMenu lets you build one by hand for free; Pro can create it quickly from a photo or PDF of your paper menu.

faq.q: Do guests need an app to open the QR menu?
faq.a: No. It opens in the browser instantly — nothing to install.

faq.q: Can I update the menu myself?
faq.a: Yes. Edit items, prices and availability at any time from your phone; changes go live when you publish.

faq.q: How do I put the QR code on tables?
faq.a: Print the A4 table-code sheet, or share the link via chat apps for counter pickup.

phan-mem-quan-ly-nha-hang-mien-phi.title: Free restaurant management software: is it really usable?
phan-mem-quan-ly-nha-hang-mien-phi.description: TaoMenu's free plan runs a small shop day to day: 1 staff seat, 1 menu language, manual entry. No POS, inventory or accounting.
phan-mem-quan-ly-nha-hang-mien-phi.answer: Yes. The free plan is enough for a small shop to run daily: 1 staff seat, 1 menu language and manual menu entry — it does not include POS, inventory or accounting.

faq.q: What exactly does the free plan include?
faq.a: 1 staff seat (2 total including the owner), 1 menu language and manual menu entry.

faq.q: What does Pro add?
faq.a: 4 staff seats, up to 5 languages, AI menu import, reviewed AI translation and dish photo enhancement, plus premium QR templates.

faq.q: Will free disappear after a trial?
faq.a: No. Free stays free; you upgrade only when you need more.

phan-mem-order-tren-dien-thoai.title: Phone ordering software: run a shop without a computer or POS
phan-mem-order-tren-dien-thoai.description: Build menus, print QR codes, take orders and record payment — all from one phone. No computer, no POS, no guest app.
phan-mem-order-tren-dien-thoai.answer: The whole workflow — building the menu, printing QR codes, receiving orders and recording payment — runs on one phone. Guests don't install anything.

faq.q: Do staff need a computer too?
faq.a: No. Staff receive and update orders from their own phones.

faq.q: Can I use it without a printer?
faq.a: Yes. Share the menu link via chat apps instead of printing QR codes.

faq.q: What about shops with many tables?
faq.a: Each table gets its own QR code, so orders arrive labeled with the table number.

menu-da-ngon-ngu.title: Multi-language restaurant menus: serve tourists without a translator
menu-da-ngon-ngu.description: Up to 5 languages on one menu. AI-assisted translation, reviewed by the owner before publishing. Built for shops serving foreign guests.
menu-da-ngon-ngu.answer: Pro supports up to 5 languages on the same menu. AI generates draft translations and the owner reviews before anything goes live — no wrong prices or bad dish names in front of guests.

faq.q: Which languages are supported?
faq.a: Any language you add to the menu; translation drafts are AI-assisted and reviewed by you.

faq.q: Does translation cost extra?
faq.a: Pro includes 20 AI translation jobs per month per store.

faq.q: Will a translation overwrite what I wrote?
faq.a: No. AI output goes to drafts, and you confirm each change before it is published.

goi-nhan-vien-bang-ma-qr.title: Call staff by QR code: guests stop waiting, staff stop walking
goi-nhan-vien-bang-ma-qr.description: Guests scan the table code to call a server or ask for the bill. Requests appear on staff phones instantly.
goi-nhan-vien-bang-ma-qr.answer: Guests scan the QR code on the table to call a server or request payment; the request appears immediately on staff phones. No shouting, no hand-waving.

faq.q: Is this included in the free plan?
faq.a: Yes. Call-server and payment requests are core free features.

faq.q: Do staff need extra devices?
faq.a: No. Requests arrive on the staff phones already in use.

faq.q: What if a guest request is unclear?
faq.a: Requests are plain text; staff accept or dismiss them and can still walk over if needed.

phan-mem-order-quan-banh-mi.title: Banh mi shop ordering software: end the rush-hour crush
phan-mem-order-quan-banh-mi.description: One shared pickup code, daily pickup numbers, and guests watch progress on their phone. Built for street shops with few or no seats.
phan-mem-order-quan-banh-mi.answer: A single pickup QR code gives each order a daily pickup number; guests watch progress on their phones. Built for street and takeaway shops without table numbers.

faq.q: Can customers order without seats?
faq.a: Yes. The shop places one public pickup code; guests order and get a pickup number.

faq.q: How are pickup numbers assigned?
faq.a: Per business day in the shop's timezone, starting from 1.

faq.q: Does the shop need a kitchen printer?
faq.a: No. Staff see the queue on their phones and call out numbers when ready.
